question: From which of the following cities did the Revolt of 1857 begin on 10 May 1857 in British India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meerut**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Revolt of 1857, also known as the First War of Indian Independence, began on **10 May 1857** in Meerut.
 
• The uprising was initiated by Indian soldiers (sepoys) in the British East India Company's army.
 
• Meerut is located in present-day Uttar Pradesh, northern India.
